details:
If I try to join a world with a semi-bad internet connection, the game will let me walk around for a couple seconds, but then the game kind of freezes.
The game is often soft locked into this state for me and I would need to restart my game completely.
*Sometimes* I would be able to access the game menu and try to navigate it, but none of the world buttons really do anything, so I can't just exit the world.
During this state my avatar can move and I can move my hands, but when I can't access the menu, my avatar disappears and I can't access the menu.
Very rarely does the game ever go back to the loading screen, but most of the time it's just soft locked completely.
Another semi-related problem is that when this bug happens, world downloads (or entering worlds that I already downloaded) are absolutely impossible, as it says 0/0 bytes or something like that, and no progress is made leading to me having to restart again.
This is on my quest 2. Last time I played with low internet was near the beginning of march, but I haven't really played since with such bad internet, so perhaps this problem is already solved.
title: Game softlocks with bad internet connection
